title: Addressing the Sibling session
description: How to write for a reader acting as Sibling session. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `sibling-session` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Boundary-marking
rules.description: Boundary-marking. State what is claimed, by whom, and on which branch. Never write as though their work were yours to resolve.

source.quote: Another agent or human on the same store, with different context and its own claims. Present precisely to mark what is NOT yours to close.
